business_summary: Doshisha Co.,Ltd., plans, develops, produces, and sells lifestyle-related products in Japan and Internationally. The company operates through two segments, Development-oriented Business Model and Wholesale Business Model. it provides a wide range of products, such as lifestyle products, such as kitchen and houseware, water bottles and tumblers, frying pan, marine leisure, outdoor leisure, sandals, and seasonal and variety goods under mosh!, evercook, shaved ice, sutto, CORELLE, PURESOME, Goroneko Summit, Perfect Globe, Doshisha Prize, and Forest Noel brands. The company also offers home appliances such as fan, massage devices, gorilla high power series, electric fan, humidifier, heater, and cooking appliance; illumination, includes CIRCULIGHT, HEXAR, and Luminous LED; and audio and visual comprises tv set, TV peripherals, and LCD display. In addition, it offers watches, jewelry, and brand bags under SUUNTO, Fitbit, Furbo design, Rubin Rosa, Orobianco, POLICE, GIULIETTAVERONA, and USPolo Assn. brands name; and beauty, footware, and branded goods under FRISK, Ajuste, PLATINUM LABEL, EVERYYOU, BIORICA, owala, TELIC, fitflop, K-Swiss, Kaepa, AIRWALK, and HEAD brands. Further, the company provides gifts such as mid-year and year-end, souvenirs and small, and casual gifts; food and confectionery, and wine; and fashion clothing under Kaepa, US Polo Assn., Lynx Sports, AIRWALK, ecko unltd., BODY GLOVE wear, and T&C Women's Clothing brands. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
